# Job 1836 - C.W. Driver LLC - Ontario Luxury Apartments

**Status:** Active - Punch List Phase  
**Client:** C.W. Driver LLC  
**Owner:** Euclid Ontario Luxury Apartments LLC  
**City:** Ontario, CA  
**Started:** August 2023  
**Estimated Completion:** Q3 2025

## Scope
Offsite and onsite water, sewer, and fire service improvements for new luxury apartment complex at 320 N. Euclid Ave, Ontario CA. Includes:
- 12-inch water main tie-in to existing CVWD main on Euclid
- Offsite 8-inch sewer main per City of Ontario
- Fire service with decorative vault lid (South Bay Foundry)
- All service laterals for 4-building complex
